Questions

Is food included in the hostel rent?

Yes. Three meals a day are covered: breakfast, a packed lunch you can carry to office, and dinner. There are no separate mess bills.

What is the rent at StayB men's hostel?

Rent is ₹7,500 per month, all-inclusive: breakfast, packed lunch for office, dinner, WiFi, laundry and ironing. The first month is ₹8,500, which includes the refundable deposit and admission.

How do I book a bed?

Tap Check Availability to WhatsApp us, or call 96333 10117. Beds are limited, so message before you travel.
